analysis.title: Not capitulatory
key_insights: Tech positioning and some momentum exposures have collapsed to multi-year lows, but JPMorgan does not classify the de-risking as capitulatory and cites lingering risks: potential Quant de-grossing and still-elevated US Tech flows.
Deutsche Bank tech positioning is at the 40th percentile, described as neutral rather than an outright short.
Goldman's sentiment indicator is still slightly positive, which leaves room before genuine pessimism.
Global hedge fund gross leverage remains at the 89th percentile over three years, even as momentum has been hit hard.
Quant gross leverage is at the 98th percentile over one year and 95th over five years, indicating large potential selling capacity.
Hedge funds sold aggressively on Thursday, but four-week flows look much less extreme, so one day does not make a capitulation.
Combined 60-day tech flows from hedge funds, retail and ETFs remain near peak levels, so tech is still crowded.
JPMorgan's US Tactical Positioning Monitor has fallen to the 33rd percentile, lower but not at panic levels.
Nvidia trades at 17.7x forward earnings, the cheapest of the Magnificent Seven, with Meta also in the teens (per Koyfin).

sector_views.rationale: Positioning has dropped to the 40th percentile at Deutsche Bank, but flows remain near peak and JPMorgan sees no capitulation.

risk_factors: Quant de-grossing from very high gross leverage levels.
US Tech flows still elevated, leaving room for further unwinding.
Sentiment and hedge fund leverage not yet at levels associated with capitulation.

tension_points.bull_case: Momentum unwind and collapsed tech positioning suggest de-risking may be largely done, with Nvidia at 17.7x forward earnings.
tension_points.bear_case: JPMorgan says the de-risking is not capitulatory: quant gross leverage is at the 98th percentile, tech flows are near peak, and hedge fund leverage is at the 89th percentile.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A quant de-grossing and a drop in the JPMorgan US Tactical Positioning Monitor well below the 33rd percentile would signal capitulation.

theme_stances.key_argument: Positioning and flows remain elevated, so the tech de-risking does not qualify as capitulation.
